newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Tabacalera buys 25 pct MIDESA.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Tabacalera buys 25 pct MIDESA.

text.p: Spanish tobacco group Tabacalera SA said on Friday that it had purchased a 24.9 percent stake in newspaper distributor MIDESA for 3.6 billion pesetas.
Tabacalera said Marco Iberica Distribucion de Ediciones (MIDESA) SA was the biggest Spanish company in the sector, with a high amount of efficiency and a solid financial position.
"This acquisition falls under Tabacalera's strategy to concentrate its growth objectives on three areas: cigarettes, cigars and distribution," the group said in a statement.
The purchase of the stake in MIDESA, which also operates in neighbouring countries, will allow Tabacelera to expand its distribution outside Spain, it said.
Tabacelera was quoting down 80 pesetas at 6,190 at midday after announcing the purchase of 2.72 million MIDESA shares.
